body:
This bounded checkpoint retains Temurin 17.0.20.1+1 / Maven 3.9.16 and resolves the explicit 157-module core/GeoNode extension candidate. Both retained-file effective-model and dependency-acquisition replays succeeded under actual IPv4/IPv6 socket denial. This is dependency resolution; no Java compilation, native test or runtime test was performed by this checkpoint.

Current tested head: `9e1b2e1bca26d00b200a39f58a4a0890d43fca98`. Base: `fnd-02/java-dependency-audit` at `b15a785f350d347c0c2c4ff07ac6e5681c1d9746` (PR #54). GitHub readback: **MERGEABLE / CLEAN**. A normal merge integrates corrected #54 and owner-merged GOV-02 main, preserving all original implementation commits, archives, snapshots and failed-run evidence. Subsequent source-closure engineering stays separate.

Frozen custody verifies 34,118 files / 1,682,220,066 bytes. The final source inventory exits 2 with 64 missing classifiers. Exact inputs, notices, 19 inspected schema-resource archives and original failed passes remain retained. Full source closure, actual dependency mediation/bindings, MapFish/GeoFence compatibility, schema rights, extension/bootstrap choices and host/toolchain closure remain explicit gaps.

Fresh integration validation: **140 Java tooling tests + 175 package tests passed**, no failures/errors/skips; strict plan validation and all four schema/example checks passed. [Fresh package test receipts](https://github.com/aloerch/ambisgis-platform/blob/9e1b2e1bca26d00b200a39f58a4a0890d43fca98/plan/verification/java-resolution-integration-package-tests.txt), [checkpoint evidence](https://github.com/aloerch/ambisgis-platform/blob/9e1b2e1bca26d00b200a39f58a4a0890d43fca98/plan/docs/java-resolution-evidence.md), [machine receipts](https://github.com/aloerch/ambisgis-platform/blob/9e1b2e1bca26d00b200a39f58a4a0890d43fca98/plan/verification/java-resolution.json), [ADR 003](https://github.com/aloerch/ambisgis-platform/blob/9e1b2e1bca26d00b200a39f58a4a0890d43fca98/plan/adrs/003-java-resolution-candidate.md), [handoff](https://github.com/aloerch/ambisgis-platform/blob/9e1b2e1bca26d00b200a39f58a4a0890d43fca98/plan/docs/java-resolution-handoff.md). Historical Maven replays and database/Jupyter native tests were not rerun for this base/documentation integration.

Owner decision: review this retained-input resolution checkpoint independently from #54. Merge order is #54 first; then verify its actual merge, integrate main normally, explicitly retarget #55 to main, and recheck the remaining diff/current tested head before the separate #55 merge decision. Both GitHub `stack` and `stackEntry` are null: no managed-stack or automatic-retarget assumption applies. Do not merge into the obsolete audit branch. No merge is authorized now.

Acceptance would establish this bounded custody/resolution checkpoint only, not Java compilation/runtime acceptance, full source/license/security closure, a product baseline, FND-07/FND-08, or FND-02 completion. FND-02 stays In progress. Pending review blocks merging only; source/compatibility work continues separately.

Refs #3.
